facts.text: An operator clinic should produce measured acceptance thresholds by scenario.

facts.quote: Thresholds are below the rate the design can deliver

facts.text: Increasingly expensive investment should occur only after four questions are answered in order: whether required data can be obtained, whether one representative system can be correlated to reality, whether that credibility can transfer to a second materially different configuration, and whether safety and legal reviewers will accept the resulting evidence.
facts.quote: Can we obtain the required data? Can we correlate one representative system to reality? Can we transfer that credibility to a second, materially different configuration? Will the safety and legal reviewers accept the resulting evidence?

facts.text: Failure at an early investment gate is more informative before a full simulation platform has been built than afterward.
